```{r setup-mascot, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot")
```

### Two calls, one id

Put `mascot("helper")` in the UI, then use the same id in the server to change its mood.
In a module, namespace the UI id with `ns()`; the module server uses the local id.

```{r mascot-wiring, echo = FALSE}
guide_wiring()
```

```{r mascot-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot", studio_character)
```
